changeSet.author: janes

and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventconf_sources WHERE name = 'opennms.wsman.eventlog.events'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO eventconf_sources (id, name, description, vendor, file_order, enabled, event_count, created_time, last_modified, uploaded_by) VALUES (nextval('eventconf_sources_id_seq'), 'opennms.wsman.eventlog.events', 'Windows event log records read by WsManEventLogd', 'opennms', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(file_order), 0) + 1 FROM eventconf_sources), TRUE, 7, NOW(), NOW(), 'system-migration');
